preregistration.title: Size-eight broad-workload confirmation
preregistration.description: Ten-replicate confirmation at the workload scale that blocked iterations 017 and 018, after the cross-task-supported contextual modulo alias in Parley 0.3.153.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict workload parity.

secondary_analysis: Report every session total and per-task ratio, never an amortized value without its denominator.
Report medians, ranges, repair-free sensitivity, first-check task and bundle rates, repairs, prompt size, protocol compliance, and hidden correctness.
Audit every first-check failure across all ten Parley bundles and report whether the iteration-018 rotation signature disappears.
Compare with iteration 018 descriptively; fresh-session stochasticity prevents deterministic attribution of absolute token movement.
preregistration.feature_boundary: The only compiler difference from iteration 018 is the evidence-backed contextual modulo spelling in 0.3.153. Position behavior and all other compiler semantics are unchanged.
preregistration.change_rule: Do not add syntax or compiler behavior from one task, transcript, or residual token gap. Any future proposal again requires recurrence across unrelated tasks plus independent general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability.
preregistration.instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character Parley skill is injected once per session and remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No further instruction-compression experiment is permitted.

source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let kept be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set count to count
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to kept
    say kept joined with "|"
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let width_input be ask for a number ""
    let width be value of width_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of number_input) to values
    let answers be an empty list of text
    for each start from 1 to count - width + 1:
        let total be 0
        for each offset from 0 to width - 1:
            set total to total + item (start + offset) of values
        add (total as text) to answers
    say answers joined with ","
source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let first_input be ask for a number ""
        let previous be value of first_input
        let current_length be 1
        let best_length be 1
        repeat (count - 1) times:
            let next_input be ask for a number ""
            let next_value be value of next_input
            if next_value is more than previous:
                set current_length to current_length + 1
            otherwise:
                set current_length to 1
            if current_length is more than best_length:
                set best_length to current_length
            set previous to next_value
        say best_length
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let counts be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let name be ask ""
        if counts contains name:
            set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of counts to 1
    if count is more than 0:
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of counts
        for each index from 2 to length of names:
            let candidate be item index of names
            let candidate_count be item candidate of counts
            if candidate_count is more than winning_count:
                set winner to candidate
                set winning_count to candidate_count
        say winner + " " + (winning_count as text)
source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let prefix be ask ""
        repeat (count - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let limit be length of prefix
            if length of line is less than limit:
                set limit to length of line
            let matching be 0
            for each index from 1 to limit:
                if matching is index - 1:
                    if item index of prefix is item index of line:
                        set matching to matching + 1
            let letters be prefix split by ""
            let shortened be an empty list of text
            for each index from 1 to matching:
                add (item index of letters) to shortened
            set prefix to shortened joined with ""
        say prefix
source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift be value of shift_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        add (ask "") to words
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        set shift to shift modulo count
        let rotated be an empty list of text
        for each index from shift + 1 to count:
            add (item index of words) to rotated
        for each index from 1 to shift:
            add (item index of words) to rotated
        say rotated joined with "|"
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let answers be an empty list of text
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be ask ""
        let first_parts be first_line split by " "
        let current_start be item 1 of first_parts as number
        let current_end be item 2 of first_parts as number
        repeat (count - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let parts be line split by " "
            let next_start be item 1 of parts as number
            let next_end be item 2 of parts as number
            if next_start is at most current_end:
                if next_end is more than current_end:
                    set current_end to next_end
            otherwise:
                add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to answers
                set current_start to next_start
                set current_end to next_end
        add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to answers
        say answers joined with ","
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let current_letter be item 1 of letters

        for each index from 2 to length of letters:
            let letter be item index of letters
            if letter is current_letter:
                set current_count to current_count + 1
            otherwise:
                add (current_letter + ":" + (current_count as text)) to groups
                set current_letter to letter
                set current_count to 1
        add (current_letter + ":" + (current_count as text)) to groups
        say groups joined with ","

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    values = [int(value) for value in lines[2:n + 2]]
    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]
    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)
    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.plurality_winner:
import sys
from collections import Counter


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    if n == 0:
        return

    counts = Counter(lines[1:n + 1])
    winner = min(counts, key=lambda name: (-counts[name], name))
    print(winner, counts[winner])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()

    if n == 0:

        return

    k %= n
    print("|".join(words[k:] + words[:k]))

source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say "0"
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say "0"
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let previous be value of first_input
            let current_length be 1
            let best_length be 1
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let next_value be value of next_input
                if next_value is more than previous:
                    set current_length to current_length + 1
                otherwise:
                    set current_length to 1
                if current_length is more than best_length:
                    set best_length to current_length
                set previous to next_value
            say best_length
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let width_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let width be value of width_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add value of number_input to values
    let answers be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each index from 1 to width:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item index of values
    add window_sum as text to answers
    if count is more than width:
        for each index from width + 1 to count:
            set window_sum to window_sum + item index of values - item (index - width) of values
            add window_sum as text to answers
    say answers joined with ","
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let retained be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set item word of seen to item word of seen + 1
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1

source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let lines be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        add ask "" to lines
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be item 1 of lines
        let prefix_letters be an empty list of text
        let still_common be yes
        if length of first_line is more than 0:
            for each position from 1 to length of first_line:
                if still_common:
                    let letter be item position of first_line
                    let shared be yes
                    if count is more than 1:
                        for each line_index from 2 to count:
                            let line be item line_index of lines
                            let line_length be length of line
                            if position is more than line_length:
                                set shared to no
                            otherwise:
                                if item position of line is not letter:
                                    set shared to no
                    if shared:
                        add letter to prefix_letters
                    otherwise:
                        set still_common to no
        say prefix_letters joined with ""
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is more than 0:
        let totals be a map from text to number
        repeat count times:
            let name be ask ""
            if totals contains name:
                set item name of totals to item name of totals + 1
            otherwise:
                set item name of totals to 1
        let names be keys of totals
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of totals
        for each index from 2 to length of names:
            let name be item index of names
            let total be item name of totals
            if total is more than winning_count:
                set winner to name
                set winning_count to total
        say winner + " " + winning_count
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current_letter be item 1 of letters
        let current_count be 1
        if length of letters is more than 1:
            for each index from 2 to length of letters:
                let letter be item index of letters
                if letter is current_letter:
                    set current_count to current_count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
                    set current_letter to letter
                    set current_count to 1
        add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
        say groups joined with ","

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    k = int(lines.readline())
    values = [int(lines.readline()) for _ in range(n)]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [str(window_sum)]
    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(str(window_sum))

    print(",".join(sums))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    if n == 0:
        print()

    prefix = lines.readline().decode().rstrip("\r\n")
    for _ in range(n - 1):

        limit = min(len(prefix), len(text))
        index = 0
        while index < limit and prefix[index] == text[index]:
            index += 1
        prefix = prefix[:index]

    print(prefix)

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k be value of k_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let next_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of next_input) to values
    let answers be an empty list of text
    for each start from 1 to (n - k + 1):
        let total be 0
        for each offset from 0 to (k - 1):
            set total to total + item (start + offset) of values
        add (total as text) to answers
    say answers joined with ","
source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first be ask ""
        let prefix be first
        repeat (n - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let limit be length of prefix
            if length of line is less than limit:
                set limit to length of line
            let shared be an empty list of text
            if limit is more than 0:
                for each i from 1 to limit:
                    if item i of prefix is item i of line:
                        add (item i of prefix) to shared
                    otherwise:
                        set limit to i - 1
            set prefix to shared joined with ""
        say prefix
source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k be value of k_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        add (ask "") to words
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let shift be k modulo n
        let result be an empty list of text
        for each i from 1 to n:
            let source be ((i + shift - 1) modulo n) + 1
            add (item source of words) to result
        say result joined with "|"
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let result be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set item word of seen to item word of seen
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to result
    say result joined with "|"
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let result be an empty list of text
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be ask ""
        let first_parts be first_line split by " "
        let current_start be item 1 of first_parts as number
        let current_end be item 2 of first_parts as number
        repeat (n - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let parts be line split by " "
            let next_start be item 1 of parts as number
            let next_end be item 2 of parts as number
            if next_start is at most current_end:
                if next_end is more than current_end:
                    set current_end to next_end
            otherwise:
                add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to result
                set current_start to next_start
                set current_end to next_end
        add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to result
        say result joined with ","
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current be item 1 of line
        let count be 1
        if length of line is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of line:
                let letter be item i of line
                if letter is current:
                    set count to count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add (current + ":" + (count as text)) to groups
                    set current to letter
                    set count to 1
        add (current + ":" + (count as text)) to groups
        say groups joined with ","
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let counts be a map from text to number
    repeat n times:
        let name be ask ""
        if counts contains name:
            set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of counts to 1
    if n is more than 0:
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let best be item winner of counts
        for each i from 1 to length of names:
            let name be item i of names
            let count be item name of counts
            if count is more than best:
                set winner to name
                set best to count
        say winner + " " + (best as text)
source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    if n is 0:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let first_input be ask for a number ""
        let previous be value of first_input
        let current be 1
        let best be 1
        repeat (n - 1) times:
            let next_input be ask for a number ""
            let next be value of next_input
            if next is more than previous:
                set current to current + 1
            otherwise:
                set current to 1
            if current is more than best:
                set best to current
            set previous to next
        say best

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    k = int(lines.readline())
    values = [int(lines.readline()) for _ in range(n)]
    current = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [current]
    for index in range(k, n):
        current += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(current)
    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    stream = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(stream.readline())
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return

    previous = int(stream.readline())
    current_length = 1
    longest = 1
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        value = int(stream.readline())
        if value > previous:
            current_length += 1
            longest = max(longest, current_length)
        else:
            current_length = 1
        previous = value
    print(longest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let k be value of k_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of value_input) to values
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each start_index from 1 to (n - k + 1):
        let total be 0
        for each offset from 0 to (k - 1):
            set total to total + item (start_index + offset) of values
        add (total as text) to output
    say output joined with ","
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be ask ""
        let first_parts be first_line split by " "
        let current_start be (item 1 of first_parts) as number
        let current_end be (item 2 of first_parts) as number
        let output be an empty list of text
        repeat (n - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let parts be line split by " "
            let next_start be (item 1 of parts) as number
            let next_end be (item 2 of parts) as number
            if next_start is at most current_end:
                if next_end is more than current_end:
                    set current_end to next_end
            otherwise:
                add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
                set current_start to next_start
                set current_end to next_end
        add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
        say output joined with ","
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let output be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set item word of seen to (item word of seen) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to output
    say output joined with "|"
source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be ask ""
        let prefix_chars be first_line split by ""
        repeat (n - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let chars be line split by ""
            let common_length be 0
            let limit be length of prefix_chars
            if length of chars is less than limit:
                set limit to length of chars
            if limit is more than 0:
                for each index from 1 to limit:
                    if item index of prefix_chars is item index of chars:
                        if common_length is index - 1:
                            set common_length to index
            repeat (length of prefix_chars - common_length) times:
                remove item (length of prefix_chars) of prefix_chars
        say prefix_chars joined with ""
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    if n is more than 0:
        let counts be a map from text to number
        repeat n times:
            let name be ask ""
            if counts contains name:
                set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
            otherwise:
                set item name of counts to 1
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of counts
        for each index from 1 to length of names:
            let name be item index of names
            let count be item name of counts
            if count is more than winning_count:
                set winner to name
                set winning_count to count
        say winner + " " + (winning_count as text)
source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let k be value of k_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        add (ask "") to words
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let shift be k modulo n
        let output be an empty list of text
        for each index from 1 to n:
            let source_index be ((index + shift - 1) modulo n) + 1
            add (item source_index of words) to output
        say output joined with "|"
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    let chars be line split by ""
    if length of chars is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let output be an empty list of text
        let current be item 1 of chars
        let run_count be 1
        if length of chars is more than 1:
            for each index from 2 to length of chars:
                let character be item index of chars
                if character is current:
                    set run_count to run_count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add (current + ":" + (run_count as text)) to output
                    set current to character
                    set run_count to 1
        add (current + ":" + (run_count as text)) to output
        say output joined with ","

            let value_input be ask for a number ""

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer.readlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    values = [int(line) for line in lines[2:2 + n]]

    current = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [current]
    for index in range(k, n):
        current += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(current)

    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer.readlines()
    n = int(lines[0])

            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)

source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let seen be a map from text to number
        let retained be an empty list of text
        repeat count times:
            let word be ask ""
            if seen contains word:
                set item word of seen to (item word of seen) + 1
            otherwise:
                set item word of seen to 1
                add word to retained
        say retained joined with "|"
source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say 0
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let previous be value of first_input
            let current_length be 1
            let best_length be 1
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let next_value be value of next_input
                if next_value is more than previous:
                    set current_length to current_length + 1
                otherwise:
                    set current_length to 1
                if current_length is more than best_length:
                    set best_length to current_length
                set previous to next_value
            say best_length
source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let shift be value of shift_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        add word to words
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let turns be shift modulo count
        repeat turns times:
            let first_word be item 1 of words
            remove item 1 of words
            add first_word to words
        say words joined with "|"
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let output be an empty list of text
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be ask ""
        let first_parts be first_line split by " "
        let current_start be (item 1 of first_parts) as number
        let current_end be (item 2 of first_parts) as number
        repeat (count - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let parts be line split by " "
            let next_start be (item 1 of parts) as number
            let next_end be (item 2 of parts) as number
            if next_start is at most current_end:
                if next_end is more than current_end:
                    set current_end to next_end
            otherwise:
                add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
                set current_start to next_start
                set current_end to next_end
        add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
        say output joined with ","
source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let prefix be ask ""
        repeat (count - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let limit be length of prefix
            if length of line is less than limit:
                set limit to length of line
            let matching be 0
            if limit is more than 0:
                for each position from 1 to limit:
                    if item position of prefix is item position of line:
                        if matching is position - 1:
                            set matching to position
            let characters be prefix split by ""
            repeat (length of characters - matching) times:
                remove item (length of characters) of characters
            set prefix to characters joined with ""
        say prefix
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let counts be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let name be ask ""
        if counts contains name:
            set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of counts to 1
    if count is more than 0:
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winner_count be item winner of counts
        for each position from 1 to length of names:
            let name be item position of names
            let name_count be item name of counts
            if name_count is more than winner_count:
                set winner to name
                set winner_count to name_count
        say (winner + " " + (winner_count as text))
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let width_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let width be value of width_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of number_input) to values
    let results be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each position from 1 to width:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item position of values
    add (window_sum as text) to results
    if count is more than width:

            add (window_sum as text) to results
    say results joined with ","

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    values = [int(value) for value in lines[2 : n + 2]]
    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]
    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)
    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current be item 1 of letters
        let count be 1
        if length of letters is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of letters:
                let letter be item i of letters
                if letter is current:
                    set count to count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add current + ":" + count to groups
                    set current to letter
                    set count to 1
        add current + ":" + count to groups
        say groups joined with ","

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set already_seen to 1
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to words
    say words joined with "|"
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let name be ask ""
        if totals contains name:
            set item name of totals to (item name of totals) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of totals to 1
    if count is more than 0:
        let names be keys of totals
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of totals
        for each i from 1 to length of names:
            let name be item i of names
            let total be item name of totals
            if total is more than winning_count:
                set winner to name
                set winning_count to total
        say winner + " " + winning_count
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let merged be an empty list of text
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be ask ""
        let first_parts be first_line split by " "
        let current_start be (item 1 of first_parts) as number
        let current_end be (item 2 of first_parts) as number
        if count is more than 1:
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let parts be line split by " "
                let next_start be (item 1 of parts) as number
                let next_end be (item 2 of parts) as number
                if next_start is at most current_end:
                    if next_end is more than current_end:
                        set current_end to next_end
                otherwise:
                    add current_start + ":" + current_end to merged
                    set current_start to next_start
                    set current_end to next_end
        add current_start + ":" + current_end to merged
        say merged joined with ","

import sys


line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip("\n")

import sys


n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
k = int(sys.stdin.readline())
values = [int(sys.stdin.readline()) for _ in range(n)]

window_sum = sum(values[:k])

source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let seen be a map from text to number
        let result be an empty list of text
        repeat count times:
            let word be ask ""
            if seen contains word:
                set item word of seen to (item word of seen) + 1
            otherwise:
                set item word of seen to 1
                add word to result
        say result joined with "|"
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is not nothing:
        let count be value of count_input
        let counts be a map from text to number
        repeat count times:
            let name be ask ""
            if counts contains name:
                set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
            otherwise:
                set item name of counts to 1
        if count is more than 0:
            let names be keys of counts
            let winner be item 1 of names
            let winning_count be item winner of counts
            for each index from 2 to length of names:
                let name be item index of names
                let name_count be item name of counts
                if name_count is more than winning_count:
                    set winner to name
                    set winning_count to name_count
            say winner + " " + winning_count
source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say 0
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let previous be value of first_input
            let current_length be 1
            let best_length be 1
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let next_value be value of next_input
                if next_value is more than previous:
                    set current_length to current_length + 1
                    if current_length is more than best_length:
                        set best_length to current_length
                otherwise:
                    set current_length to 1
                set previous to next_value
            say best_length
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    let letters be line split by ""
    let groups be an empty list of text
    if length of letters is more than 0:
        let current_letter be item 1 of letters
        let current_count be 1
        for each index from 2 to length of letters:
            let letter be item index of letters
            if letter is current_letter:
                set current_count to current_count + 1
            otherwise:
                add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
                set current_letter to letter
                set current_count to 1
        add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
    say groups joined with ","
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let window_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let window_size be value of window_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add value of number_input to values
    let sums be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each index from 1 to window_size:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item index of values
    add window_sum to sums
    if count is more than window_size:
        for each index from window_size + 1 to count:
            set window_sum to window_sum + item index of values - item (index - window_size) of values
            add window_sum to sums
    say sums joined with ","
source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let shift be value of shift_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        add ask "" to words
    let result be an empty list of text
    if count is more than 0:
        let remaining_shift be shift
        repeat shift times:
            if remaining_shift is at least count:
                set remaining_shift to remaining_shift - count
        if remaining_shift is less than count:
            if remaining_shift is more than 0:
                for each index from remaining_shift + 1 to count:
                    add item index of words to result
            for each index from 1 to remaining_shift:
                add item index of words to result
    say result joined with "|"

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    values = [int(value) for value in lines[2 : n + 2]]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]
    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)
    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    if n == 0:
        print()
        return

    words = lines[2 : n + 2]
    offset = k % n
    rotated = words[offset:] + words[:offset]
    print("|".join(rotated))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is not nothing:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is more than 0:
            let counts be a map from text to number
            repeat count times:
                let name be ask ""
                if counts contains name:
                    set item name of counts to (item name of counts + 1)
                otherwise:
                    set item name of counts to 1
            let names be keys of counts
            let winner be item 1 of names
            let winning_count be item winner of counts
            for each i from 1 to length of names:
                let name be item i of names
                let name_count be item name of counts
                if name_count is more than winning_count:
                    set winner to name
                    set winning_count to name_count
            say winner + " " + winning_count
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_line be ask ""
            let first_parts be first_line split by " "
            let current_start be (item 1 of first_parts) as number
            let current_end be (item 2 of first_parts) as number
            let output be an empty list of text
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let parts be line split by " "
                let next_start be (item 1 of parts) as number
                let next_end be (item 2 of parts) as number
                if next_start is at most current_end:
                    if next_end is more than current_end:
                        set current_end to next_end
                otherwise:
                    add current_start + ":" + current_end to output
                    set current_start to next_start
                    set current_end to next_end
            add current_start + ":" + current_end to output
            say output joined with ","

source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current_letter be item 1 of letters
        let current_count be 1
        if length of letters is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of letters:
                let letter be item i of letters
                if letter is current_letter:
                    set current_count to current_count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
                    set current_letter to letter
                    set current_count to 1
        add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
        say groups joined with ","
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let window_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let window_size be value of window_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        add value of value_input to values
    let results be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each i from 1 to window_size:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values
    add window_sum to results
    if count is more than window_size:
        for each i from (window_size + 1) to count:
            set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values - item (i - window_size) of values
            add window_sum to results
    say results joined with ","

source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
import sys


def main():
    stream = sys.stdin
    n = int(stream.readline())
    if n == 0:
        print()
        return

    prefix = stream.readline().rstrip("\n")
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        text = stream.readline().rstrip("\n")
        limit = min(len(prefix), len(text))
        index = 0
        while index < limit and prefix[index] == text[index]:
            index += 1
        prefix = prefix[:index]

    print(prefix)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
import sys


def main():
    stream = sys.stdin
    n = int(stream.readline())
    seen = set()
    retained = []
    for _ in range(n):
        word = stream.readline().rstrip("\n")
        if word not in seen:
            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)
    print("|".join(retained))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main():
    stream = sys.stdin
    n = int(stream.readline())
    k = int(stream.readline())
    values = [int(stream.readline()) for _ in range(n)]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]
    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)
    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    stream = sys.stdin
    n = int(stream.readline())
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return

    previous = int(stream.readline())
    current_length = 1
    longest = 1
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        value = int(stream.readline())
        if value > previous:
            current_length += 1
            longest = max(longest, current_length)
        else:
            current_length = 1
        previous = value
    print(longest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is not nothing:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is more than 0:
            let counts be a map from text to number

            say winner + " " + (winning_count as text)

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let window_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let window_size be value of window_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of number_input) to values
    let output be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each i from 1 to window_size:
        set window_sum to window_sum + (item i of values)
    add (window_sum as text) to output
    let window_count be count - window_size + 1
    if window_count is more than 1:
        for each start from 2 to window_count:
            set window_sum to window_sum - (item (start - 1) of values)
            set window_sum to window_sum + (item (start + window_size - 1) of values)
            add (window_sum as text) to output
    say output joined with ","
source_texts.rotate_words_left:

    if count is 0:
        say ""

        let shift be rotation modulo count
        let output be an empty list of text
        for each i from 1 to count:
            let source_index be ((i + shift - 1) modulo count) + 1
            add (item source_index of words) to output
        say output joined with "|"

source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    seen = set()
    retained = []

    for raw_word in lines[1:n + 1]:
        word = raw_word.decode()
        if word not in seen:
            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)

    print("|".join(retained))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main():
    values = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n, k = values[0], values[1]
    numbers = values[2:2 + n]
    window_sum = sum(numbers[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]

    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += numbers[index] - numbers[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)

    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    words = [line.decode() for line in lines[2:2 + n]]

    if n:
        k %= n
        words = words[k:] + words[:k]
    print("|".join(words))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current be item 1 of letters
        let run_count be 1
        if length of letters is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of letters:
                let letter be item i of letters
                if letter is current:
                    set run_count to run_count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add current + ":" + run_count to groups
                    set current to letter
                    set run_count to 1
        add current + ":" + run_count to groups
        say groups joined with ","
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set item word of seen to item word of seen
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to words
    say words joined with "|"
source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let first_input be ask for a number ""
        let previous be value of first_input
        let current_length be 1
        let best_length be 1
        if count is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to count:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let next_value be value of next_input
                if next_value is more than previous:
                    set current_length to current_length + 1
                otherwise:
                    set current_length to 1
                if current_length is more than best_length:
                    set best_length to current_length
                set previous to next_value
        say best_length
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let counts be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let name be ask ""
        if counts contains name:
            set item name of counts to item name of counts + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of counts to 1
    if count is more than 0:
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of counts
        if length of names is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of names:
                let name be item i of names
                let name_count be item name of counts
                if name_count is more than winning_count:
                    set winner to name
                    set winning_count to name_count
        say winner + " " + winning_count

source_texts.run_length_encoding:
import sys


line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip("\n")

if not line:
    print()
else:
    groups = []
    current = line[0]
    count = 1

    for letter in line[1:]:
        if letter == current:
            count += 1
        else:
            groups.append(f"{current}:{count}")
            current = letter
            count = 1

    groups.append(f"{current}:{count}")
    print(",".join(groups))
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
import sys


n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
seen = set()
retained = []

for _ in range(n):
    word = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip("\n")
    if word not in seen:
        seen.add(word)
        retained.append(word)

print("|".join(retained))
source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
import sys


n = int(sys.stdin.readline())

if n == 0:
    print()
else:
    prefix = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip("\n")

    for _ in range(n - 1):
        line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip("\n")
        limit = min(len(prefix), len(line))
        index = 0
        while index < limit and prefix[index] == line[index]:
            index += 1
        prefix = prefix[:index]

    print(prefix)

import sys


n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
k = int(sys.stdin.readline())

    offset = k % n
    rotated = words[offset:] + words[:offset]

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
k = int(sys.stdin.readline())
values = [int(sys.stdin.readline()) for _ in range(n)]

window_sum = sum(values[:k])
sums = [window_sum]

for index in range(k, n):
    window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
    sums.append(window_sum)

print(",".join(map(str, sums)))
